prompts: A wide, low-angle shot of a dimly lit circular office corridor at night, flickering fluorescent lights overhead, a cracked fire-hose glass panel on the wall, a wall clock frozen at 3:17, and dark worn tracks on the carpet. A square-faced man, 28-32, with a short buzz cut, an old scar on his temple, medium-thin build, wearing a wrinkled white shirt with a dry pen in the left chest pocket, dark grey trousers, a loose tie, and black leather shoes, his right hand clenched around a shard of broken glass, stands at the far end. A plastic water bottle stands under the light, droplets sliding upward. He sprints toward it, reaching out, but the instant his fingers touch the bottle, it and the droplets vanish in place. He lunges through empty air and drops to his knees, staring at his empty hand, whispering in shock. The camera slowly pushes in, keeping the cold, high-pressure, surreal atmosphere.

A medium handheld tracking shot follows a Chinese man, 28-32, square face, short buzz cut, old scar on his temple, medium-thin build, wearing a wrinkled white shirt and dark grey dress slacks, a dry pen clipped in his left chest pocket, his right hand clenched around a shard of broken glass, loosened tie hanging around his neck. He walks in a dim circular office corridor at night, fluorescent lights flickering, dark trampled stains on the carpet, a cracked fire-hose cabinet, a wall clock frozen at 3:17. He glances back at a plastic water bottle three meters behind him on the floor, then slowly sidesteps to its rear flank, counting under his breath, and suddenly lunges. The bottle vanishes, all corridor lights click off for two seconds, then flicker back on: the bottle sits behind the cracked glass of the fire-hose cabinet, a 'drinking water' label on its body. Cold blue-green palette, harsh overhead fluorescent glow, tense handheld sway, 832x480 landscape.

A wiry man with a square face, short buzz cut, and an old scar on his temple, wearing a wrinkled white shirt with a dry pen in the left chest pocket and dark grey trousers with a loose tie, stands in a dim circular office corridor at night. Flickering fluorescent light casts cold blue-green tones on the carpet's dark trampled marks. Shot in close-up from a low angle, the camera slowly pushes in and arcs toward his front. He grips a shard of broken glass in his right hand and strikes a fire-hydrant glass panel three times; cracks spread, his breathing heaves, and on the third blow the whole pane shatters. He thrusts his hand inside to grab a water bottle. A wall clock reads 3:17. Landscape 832x480.

Close-up, fixed camera, shallow depth of field, landscape 832x480. A man with a square face, short buzz cut, an old scar on his temple, medium-thin build, wearing a wrinkled white shirt with a dry pen in the left chest pocket and dark grey trousers, a loosened tie around his neck, black leather shoes, his right hand always clutching a piece of broken glass. He stands beside a cracked fire hydrant in a dim office corridor at night, fluorescent lights flickering, a wall clock frozen at 3:17, dark trampled marks on the carpet. He twists off a bottle cap, tilts his head back to pour — not a single drop falls. He freezes, eyes wide, then snaps his head toward the far end of the corridor as rapid leather-shoe footsteps echo. Cold, high-pressure, surreal thriller palette.

A medium-wide shot in a dim, flickering office corridor at night, the camera fixed but slowly tilting upward. A square-faced man with a short buzz cut and an old scar on his temple, medium-thin build, wearing a wrinkled white shirt and dark grey trousers, a dry pen in his left chest pocket, his right hand always clutching a piece of broken glass, his tie loose around his neck, sidesteps wearily and slides down the wall to sit on the stained carpet. Another identical figure lunges past him, misses, and crashes headfirst into a fire hydrant whose cracked glass door shatters. The seated man, exhausted, hurls an empty bottle down the corridor; it rolls and stops far away. The camera tilts up to reveal a pair of still feet standing beside the bottle. Cold fluorescent light, greenish shadows, surreal tension.
